name: dokkaebi
description: Windows Electron paper-trading and deterministic research platform
author: Dokkaebi contributors

scripts.test: pnpm run preflight && pnpm run build && node scripts/run-tests-isolated.js
scripts.desktop: pnpm run preflight && pnpm run build && electron apps/desktop
scripts.desktop:dev: pnpm run preflight && pnpm run build && electron apps/desktop
scripts.package:win: pnpm run preflight && pnpm run build && electron-builder --win nsis
scripts.release:check: pnpm run preflight && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run build && node scripts/release-readiness.js
scripts.evidence:rehearse: pnpm run preflight && pnpm run build && node scripts/evidence-rehearse.js
scripts.evidence:status: pnpm run preflight && pnpm run build && node scripts/evidence-cli.js status
scripts.evidence:export: pnpm run preflight && pnpm run build && node scripts/evidence-cli.js export
scripts.evidence:verify: pnpm run preflight && pnpm run build && node scripts/evidence-cli.js verify
